title: Real son asks for a small, usual amount (no pressure)
_tests: A money ask alone must not trigger an alarm when it matches the person's history and has no pressure or secrecy.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Maa, it's Sujeet. Did you eat?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes beta, just now. Tell me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Like last time, can you send two thousand for my train ticket to Lucknow? My card isn't working on the app.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No hurry, tonight is fine. I'll give it back on Sunday when I come, and I'll tell Suvaani you helped.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'll send it after dinner.
